thread:
maya: Heads-up — planning to enable the new structured output toggle tomorrow 09:00 UTC. Need quick alignment on how the client SDK should behave for older clients that don't support function-style responses. TL;DR: toggle is `structured_output_v2`; default rollout will be canaryed.

kevin: quick q — what are the canary audiences? internal only, beta customers, percentage?

maya: plan is -> 5% internal devs first, then 20% orgs on our beta list, then full. If metrics look good we'll ramp. Canary config will be keyed by org_id and percentage.

sam: for SDK behaviour: should we auto-detect capability or require clients to set a header? Auto-detect could be flaky.

maya: leaning to explicit capability header to avoid accidental breakage. propose `X-Client-Capabilities: structured=true|false`. SDKs can set it when they know they support new shape. If header missing, server treats as legacy.

liz: if server gets a request from a client that claims structured=true but the payload isn't parseable, what's fallback? silent fallback or error?

maya: good point. proposal: three compat modes on the flag: `enforce` (error and surface to caller), `warn` (accept and log telemetry), `lenient` (accept and try to coerce/normalize). Canary will use `warn`. Full rollout will move to `enforce` only after alarms clear.

kevin: can we see the sample flag JSON we'll push?

maya: snippet we plan to deploy to LaunchCtl: ```json
{
  "flag_key": "structured_output_v2",
  "audiences": [
    { "type": "internal", "percent": 5 },
    { "type": "org_list", "ids": ["org-abc", "org-beta"], "percent": 20 }
  ],
  "default_mode": "warn",
  "telemetry_enabled": true
}
```

sam: love the explicitness. For SDKs: propose these behaviors:
- if header `structured=true` -> call structured response parsing path; if parse fails and mode=`warn` -> fall back to raw text API and emit `structured.parse_failure` metric; if mode=`enforce` -> surface error to user with clear message.
- if header missing -> use legacy path.

arianne: also add rate-limited user-facing fallback message so apps get deterministic errors (don't spam logs).

maya: agreed. add an SDK flag `structuredFallbackPolicy` with values `client_log`, `user_error`, `silent`. Default `client_log` for now.

liz: telemetry names we should instrument: `structured.request`, `structured.parse_failure`, `structured.enforce_violation`. Include `org_id`, `client_version`, `flag_mode` as dimensions.

maya: yes. we'll also add an alert rule: if `structured.parse_failure` > 0.5% of structured requests over 5m window for canary audience, pause ramp and notify eng-platform @here.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout created for flag `structured_output_v2` (id: flag-785). Audience: internal devs 5%. Started at 2026-03-17T09:00:00Z.

kevin: timeline question — how long do we keep `warn` before switching to `enforce`?

maya: target 72h stable window with parse_failure < 0.1% and no customer-reported issues in that period. If not met, we keep `warn` and expand audience slowly.

sam: for SDK releases, do we ship new minor with header defaulting to structured=false? Or opt-in?

maya: opt-in. We don't want to force older apps to change behavior. New SDKs released in beta will set header automatically for apps that enable the new SDK feature. Document in the changelog.

arianne: quick ask — do we need client-side schema versions? e.g. `structured_version=2` to allow future compatibility?

maya: yep add `X-Client-Capabilities: structured=true;version=2`. Server will validate version and provide fallback advice in error payloads.

liz: code review ping — @sam can you draft the SDK changes and raise a PR? I can review and add tests for fallback metrics.

sam: on it, will open PR later today.

maya: I'll update the rollout doc and LaunchCtl entry. Posting the canary runbook here in a sec — includes rollback steps: set flag to `off` for audience or flip mode to `lenient`, and emergency kill switch is `feature_kill_switch:structured_output` which bypasses structured paths entirely.

kevin: one more — QA: we should run an adversarial test that sends malformed function-calls and weird orderings. I'll add tests to integration suite.

maya: perfect. thanks everyone. If any objections please reply by EOD, otherwise we'll ship tomorrow. :thumbsup:

liz: :+1:

sam: noted. PR will reference `flag-785`.

deploy-bot: Canary completed for internal audience. Metrics collection ongoing.

maya: follow-ups: I'll add alert dashboards and the `% breakdown by client_version` panel. Also putting a tiny runbook under /runbooks/structured-output-canary (internal wiki).
